subject: [PATCH 1/2] sched/numa: do not let the per-VMA PID filter gate promotion

reviews.author: Gregory Price
reviews.summary: Proposed a simple fix to address the issue reported by sashiko, involving setting vma->numab_state->slow_only to false when scanning over two passes. Stated that they will follow up with a v2 next week after testing.

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a performance issue in the Linux kernel's NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) balancing mechanism, specifically related to VMA (Virtual Memory Area) scanning and promotion. The existing implementation prevents new scans from causing faults for potentially hours or days by filtering out VMAs that have not been hint-faulted. However, this leads to a situation where large shmem VMAs can hold the scan cursor for an extended period, causing other VMAs to be skipped due to 'inactivity'. The patch series introduces a new restricted scan mechanism that scans rejected VMAs and looks only at folios on non-toptier nodes, promoting candidates from the whole address space while maintaining top-tier marking unchanged.
